products.title: DDP 2017-Present L5P Duramax CP3 Conversion Kit
products.body_html:
DDP 2017-Present L5P Duramax CP3 Conversion Kit converts the factory high-pressure fuel system to a Dan's Diesel Performance CP3 setup.

Choose a 10mm, 12mm, or 14mm pump based on injector size and horsepower goals. The kit includes the CP3 pump with mounting flange and drive gear, nickel-treated high-pressure lines, feed and return fittings, rail-port cap, and FCA extension harness.

  • Fitment: 2017-present GM 6.6L L5P Duramax
  • 10mm: intended for moderate performance combinations
  • 12mm: rated around 1,050 HP and recommended for trucks with 100-200% over injectors
  • 14mm: intended for competition trucks with built engines and very large injectors
  • Warranty: Manufacturer warranty varies by pump selection

Contact Lucky Diesel before ordering if you need help confirming fitment or supporting fuel-system requirements.

products.title: DDP Dominator 72mm Turbocharger 05-10
products.body_html:
DDP Dominator 72mm Turbocharger 05-10

This charger fits 2005-2010 Chevrolet/GMC 6.6L LLY, LBZ, and LMM Duramax Diesel trucks.

The Dominator 72mm Turbocharger is engineered using all-new, enhanced castings for superior durability and performance. Designed to support up to 900-950 horsepower with the proper fuel modifications. If you want to win, you have to push the limits. That is what we have done in order to bring the 72mm Dominator to market. This turbo has spent over three years in development and has proven to dominate in the Work Stock and Stock Appearing turbo truck classes. If you're looking for the best drop-in turbo on the market for your truck, nothing beats a DDP Dominator.

Benefits of this turbo include:

  • Brand New Turbo. No core charge.
  • New vane actuator
  • New vane position sensor
  • 100% Drop-In
  • Heavy-Duty shaft bearings with outer oil groove for improved lubrication and cooling properties
  • 360* Jetted Thrust bearing
  • Billet High Flow vane package
  • DDP Exclusive 80x74mm turbine made out of Mar-M alloy, thick blades and 8mm shaft. Available in 9 or 10 blade.
  • DDP Exclusive 72mm Billet 7075 Compressor Wheel
  • CNC Ported Exhaust Housing Inlets
  • Improved Compressor cover design with better placed MAP groove, thick bore to prevent cracking, and ribbed outlet for anti-slip surface for boot.
  • Stock Appearing Class Legal
  • VSR Balanced to ISO specification.
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty

Recommended fuel setup to maximize the power potential of this turbo would be 250-300% injectors paired with a 14mm CP3. All available from Dan's Diesel Performance.



products.title: AMDP 2020-2022 6.7L Powerstroke EZ LYNK Transmission Tuning
products.body_html:
AMDP custom transmission tuning for 2020-2022 Ford 6.7L Powerstroke trucks using EZ LYNK. Transmission tuning improves power delivery and is strongly recommended with engine tuning above the 50 HP setting.

Calibration changes

  • Shift firmness and pressure
  • Shift points
  • Torque-converter lockup
  • Torque management

VIN required: Lucky Diesel needs the vehicle VIN to fulfill this tuning product and will contact you if it is not supplied with the order.

products.title: EZ-lynk AutoAgent 3
products.body_html:
The EZ Lynk Auto Agent 3 is a cloud-based tuning and monitoring device for diesel trucks. It plugs into the OBDII port and pairs with the EZ Lynk app on a phone or tablet, so tune files, live data and diagnostics are all handled from the driver's seat. No laptop, and no trip to a shop to change a tune.

This listing is the blank device: hardware only, with no tune files loaded. Tuning is purchased separately.
